_comment: Example request body for POST /outbound. This replaces a previous body.json that was leftover test data from an unrelated debt-collection product (real-looking phone numbers, a customer name, EMI/due-date/salary fields, and a real client's name) and didn't even match this API's actual schema. This one does. Send it with header 'x-api-key: <your OUTBOUND_API_KEY>'.
